policies.never: must not exist at all; every appearance is leftover
policies.idle: a regenerable cache untouched for `days` is leftover
policies.declared: curated by a person, measured and reported, never swept
policies.allowed: local state that belongs here; measured only

Library/.regenerated_by: Unity reimports the project on the next open
Library/.note: Never byte-walked: 33k files cost 8 s. Idleness is read from the sentinels, because a directory mtime only tracks its immediate children.

Logs/.note: Grows 12-65 files/day. Six weeks is the agreed window.

Captures/.note: Curated by hand under ai/README.md Workspace retention. Documents cite files here, so the sweep must never reach it.

TestResults/.note: Documents cite files here. Never swept.

Art/.note: Gitignored yet cited by canon, and the images are not reproducible. Never swept.

*.csproj.note: Unity regenerates these. An empty one (zero <Compile> entries) is leftover, but only Unity knows when.

*.slnx.note: One solution file. Four had accumulated, three of them naming projects that no longer exist.

debug*.log.note: A ring bounded to four files by GameLogSettings.cs. Deleting them costs the current session's traces.

**/*.asd.note: Ableton sidecars for the composer's own tracks. They hold warp markers and per-track gain, not just a waveform cache, so they are authored state and are never swept.

Assets/InitTestScene*.unity.regenerated_by: the Unity Test Framework, on the next PlayMode run that does not exit cleanly
Assets/InitTestScene*.unity.note: Half-life measured in hours; 25 pairs had accumulated inside the asset database.

TestResults-*.xml.note: Appears when a batch run is given -testResults with a path at the repository root. Point it inside TestResults/ instead.

**/*.blend1.note: The autosave is worthless once its .blend is committed, and load-bearing while it is not. The sweep refuses one whose .blend has uncommitted changes.

worktrees.note: Patterned, never one row per worktree, so adding or removing a worktree needs no edit here and cannot leave a rotting row. Three idle Library/ caches in sibling worktrees held 5.7 GB.
